text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Unusual auth traffic spike from proxy-prod observed. 6000 auth failures/min to /v1/auth/token from ~19 distinct service principals. Possible leaked debug logs containing tokens referenced in traces. Root: 1891002468

oncall-bot: Auto-created incident INC-2026-0315-42 and paging oncall (ops_pager). Attach logs: s3://redwood-logs-prod/proxy/2026/03/15/1891002400-debug-rolling.gz (partial obj).

sam (sre): I'm on it. Can someone paste the initial filter used? I'm pulling cloudfront/WAF logs now.

mira (security): @sam saw correlated access to internal /kv/session endpoint from two new k8s nodes in us-west-2. IPs: 34.219.112.9, 3.238.45.60. Looks like automated probe.

sam (sre): Copy. I've temporarily added a WAF rule to block those two IPs and rate-limit auth endpoints to 10r/s per IP. Will monitor.

dan (eng-runtime): Noted. If tokens were leaked in debug artifacts, we should rotate service tokens used by runtime: runtime-read, runtime-write, proxy-svc. Do we have rotation playbook?

mira (security): Yes — follow playbook: rotate tokens in IAM, invalidate existing sessions, update secrets in Vault, and rotate any KMS data keys if they were exposed. I'll coordinate.

ops_pager: Confirmed received page. Handoff to sam for mitigation, mira for forensics, dan for key rotation ops.

kelly (customer-success): Heads-up — I might need a customer-facing note if this hits any active customer consoles. Any sign of customer data access?

mira (security): No confirmed exfil yet. The access pattern is auth attempts and a handful of GETs to /debug/logs which returned 403 mostly, but one request succeeded and returned a gzipped archive containing verbose logs. We redacted PII quickly but tokens may be present.

sam (sre): Quick mitigation checklist I'm executing now:
- Block suspicious IPs (done)
- Add temporary ACL on internal /debug/* endpoints (nginx) to internal nets only (in progress)
- Disable debug-logging buckets' public-read (done)
- Throttle token endpoints globally to reduce blast radius (done)

mira (security): Start token rotation: list of affected identities: runtime-proxy, analytics-ingest, model-cache-writer. We'll rotate in this order: non-prod test keys -> consumer-facing keys -> internal critical keys last with staged rollout. Dan, can you coordinate deploy window?

dan (eng-runtime): I can push rotations to k8s secrets with a canary rollout. Plan: rotate one replica per region, validate auth flows, then rollout cluster-wide. Need ~15m per region; total ~45m.

sam (sre): We should also snapshot current KV cache and enable fallback to read-only caches for a short window to reduce churn on auth. Dan, possible?

dan (eng-runtime): Yes — enabling readonly cache mode now (at 1891002590). Will report back.

sec-bot: Forensics note: saved copy of suspect object s3://redwood-logs-prod/proxy/2026/03/15/1891002400-debug-rolling.gz to forensic-bucket (read-only) and rotated the public URL. Access audit saved.

mira (security): Running grep for token regex in the archive. If tokens present we need to target rotate those credentials immediately.

sam (sre): Observed auth latency spike down to 200ms p95 after rate-limits. Error rate for normal customers is up ~1.8% from baseline. No full outages.

kelly (customer-success): If we have a small bump in error rate, I'll draft a short customer message saying we are investigating auth anomalies and that some requests may see transient auth errors while we rotate keys. Want to avoid panic.

mira (security): Found tokens in a debug file (masked snippet):
```
2026-03-15T09:37:02Z DEBUG token=eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1Ni...REDACTED..q9Z session_id=xyz
```
Action: rotate those token families now.

dan (eng-runtime): Starting rotation for analytics-ingest now (canary in us-west-2). Applying new secret to 1 pod.

sam (sre): Observability: enabling extra sampling on auth traces and tagging these requests as "suspicious-auth-0315".

ops_pager: Please add oncall followups to INC-2026-0315-42. Also create postmortem link once stabilized.

mira (security): Rotation status update:
- analytics-ingest: rotated -> validated (us-west-2 canary green)
- runtime-proxy: in-progress (1/3 regions)
- model-cache-writer: pending

dan (eng-runtime): runtime-proxy rotated in us-west-2 and eu-central canary started. No regressions so far. 

sam (sre): Traffic from the two suspect IPs stopped after WAF block. New suspicious IPs popped briefly (3.236.10.5) — blocked as well. Adding temporary geo-block for rare ASN ranges for 2 hours.

mira (security): We're going to revoke the leaked token family across all environments and force short-lived credentials with stricter TTLs. Also notifying cloud provider of suspicious VMs.

kelly (customer-success): Draft customer blurb ready. Wants approval: "We detected anomalous authentication attempts affecting a small percentage of requests. We've implemented mitigations and are rotating credentials. Some customers may see transient auth errors. We'll provide updates within 2 hours." Approve?

sam (sre): Approve. Keep it factual and non-alarming.

ops_pager: Timecheck: 18 minutes since page. Current impact: ~1-2% error rate, primarily token validation failures; no confirmed data exfil beyond the single debug artifact.

mira (security): Recommend full key rotation for any keys appearing in the artifact. Also schedule KMS data key rotation if any envelopes reference the leaked tokens (investigating).

dan (eng-runtime): model-cache-writer rotation starting now. ETA 20m.

sec-bot: Audit log: 8 unique principals accessed debug bucket between 09:34 and 09:38 UTC. Two of those principals are service accounts with recently created keys. Flagging for review.

sam (sre): mitigations in place checklist update:
- IP blocks: in place
- WAF rules: in place
- Rate-limits: in place
- Debug endpoints locked down: in place
- Token rotation: in progress
- Customer comms: drafted

mira (security): Also escalating to legal for potential PII exposure review. @kelly please share the draft with legal.

kelly (customer-success): Sent to legal, they acknowledged and will review within the hour.

sam (sre): Rolling handoff in 40m. I'll remain on rotation until then unless major escalation. If anybody needs me DM.

dan (eng-runtime): model-cache-writer rotated and validated. All critical rotations complete. Deploy-bot: marking rollout stable.

deploy-bot: Canary -> 1/3 -> 3/3 rollouts completed for rotated secrets. No deploy failures reported.

mira (security): Forensics takeaway: attacker likely discovered a temporary debug artifact and used contained tokens to probe service endpoints. Impact limited by quick WAF blocking and fast rotation. Postmortem required; include why debug artifacts were accessible and how to prevent future leakage (S3 lifecycle + stricter bucket policies + CI gating).

ops_pager: Current status: mitigated - active rotation complete, monitoring. Keeping incident open for 6 hours for follow-up and postmortem.

kelly (customer-success): Sending customer note now. Will update once legal confirms wording.

sam (sre): New suspicious access attempt at 09:59 from a different ASN blocked by WAF. No token use detected. Monitoring.

mira (security): Logging final actions and moving to evidence collection. Please add any extra logs to forensic-bucket.

ops_pager: Handoff: @sam -> next oncall (sam_outgoing) at 10:20 UTC. Please sync via DM.

sam (sre): Handoff ack. Will write incident runbook notes in INC-2026-0315-42 and list follow-ups: tighten bucket policies, ensure no debug logging in prod by default, rotate any short-lived keys found in logs.

mira (security): Thanks team. Closing note: reopen if any auth anomalies rise above baseline.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-42 status updated to: mitigated. Link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-0315-42
